entities.summary: Ximena Cecilia Rincón González is a Chilean lawyer and politician. She served as a cabinet minister during the second government of President Michelle Bachelet, holding the positions of Minister Secretary-General of the Presidency (2014–2015) and Minister of Labor and Social Providence (2015–2016). Later, she was elected senator for the Maule Region (2018–2026) and served as President of the Senate from August 2021 to March 2022.
